comments: Absolute intensity (intensity/100 neutron captures by {+80}Se) measured by 1971Ra07. Intensities calibrated relative to I(479|g) in boron(n,|g) (for low E|g) and I(7367.7|g) in Pb(n,|g) (for high E|g); uncertainty |?10% for E|g|<2000, 15% for E|g>2000. Absolute intensity data from 'Budapest data' in 2007ChZX are in satisfactory agreement for the 468|g and 4976|g, but are typically high by factors of 2 to 16 for the other lines common to both studies.
